title: Lists sidebar, create and delete lists, the /lists/[id] page
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-02-organise.md → 'The list page' (sidebar; /lists/), 'Validation messages' (list name), 'App' (lists-nav, lists/[id]/page, lists/actions). The lists domain (listLists/getList/createList/deleteList/isDuplicateListError, parseListName, DUPLICATE_LIST_MESSAGE, ListFilter.listId) exists on this branch. Read src/app/page.tsx, components/*, actions.ts, how/tasks.md, how/scheduling.md. Deliver: - src/app/lists/actions.ts ("use server"): `createListAction(prev: { error?: string; value?: string }, formData)`: parseListName(formData.get("name")); on error return { error, value }; createList; if isDuplicateListError → { error: DUPLICATE_LIST_MESSAGE, value }; revalidatePath("/"); return {}. `deleteListAction(formData)`: parseTaskId(formData.get("id")); deleteList; revalidatePath("/"); redirect("/") (outside try/catch). - src/app/components/lists-nav.tsx: server component `ListsNav({ lists, currentListId })` rendering `
`: link "All tasks" to "/" (aria-current="page" when no current list), one link per list to `/lists/` with text ` ()` (aria-current on the current one), and a client `NewListForm` (separate file new-list-form.tsx, useActionState(createListAction, {})) with input labelled "List name" (name="name"), button "Create list", error in `

`, form keyed on a nonce so it clears on success (return { nonce: Date.now() } on success). - Shared page body: extract the list-page rendering from src/app/page.tsx into `src/app/components/task-page.tsx` (`TaskPage({ list, show, q, today })` server component) that fetches lists and tasks and renders: ListsNav, heading (h1 "harness-demo" stays in the layout/header; the page heading h2? keep the existing structure: use the list name as the page's main heading when scoped, "All tasks" otherwise, as an h2 above the filter bar), FilterBar (links must preserve the /lists/ base path), AddTaskForm (with a hidden `listId` input = current list id, and the add action defaulting listId from it), TaskList. - src/app/lists/[id]/page.tsx: `params` Promise; parseTaskId; getList or notFound(); render TaskPage scoped (`listTasks(..., { listId })`) plus a "Delete list" form: button with aria-label `Delete list: ` posting to deleteListAction with hidden id. force-dynamic. - src/app/page.tsx: renders TaskPage unscoped. - src/app/actions.ts addTask: read listId from the form (hidden input) and pass `{ listIds }` from listLists to parseTaskInput so an unknown id yields the "List does not exist." error; revalidatePath("/") and revalidatePath(`/lists/${listId}`) when set. - Component tests: lists-nav.test.tsx (links, counts, aria-current), new-list-form.test.tsx (label, button, error alert). - Docs: create docs/current/how/lists.md (tier 2): intro; `![Lists](../diagrams/lists-and-filters.svg)` + `` Mermaid flowchart: URL (/ or /lists/) → page → getList/notFound → TaskPage → listLists + listTasks({listId, show, q}) → sidebar with counts + sections; create-list and delete-list actions with their messages and ON DELETE SET NULL. Key entry points (both pages, TaskPage, ListsNav, NewListForm, lists/actions, lists repository, parseListName). Mechanism with exact accessible names and messages; failure modes (duplicate name, deleting the list you are viewing, unknown id). Add to _overview.md (Documents + Diagrams `lists-and-filters`) and README map; date line. Update how/tasks.md entry points for TaskPage. Files likely touched: src/app/lists/** (new), src/app/components/{lists-nav,new-list-form,task-page}.tsx (new) + tests, src/app/page.tsx, src/app/actions.ts, src/app/components/add-task-form.tsx (hidden listId), src/app/components/filter-bar.tsx (base path), docs/current/how/lists.md (new), docs/current/how/tasks.md, docs/current/_overview.md, docs/current/README.md. Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check (stale data-model and missing lists-and-filters are the only allowed diagram findings). Existing e2e must keep passing post-merge.
acceptance_criteria: In-worktree gates pass (allowed diagram findings only). Sidebar with counts and New list form; /lists/[id] scoped page with Delete list; addTask defaults listId from the page and validates it; how/lists.md exists and is listed. Post-merge: existing 15 e2e still pass.
